summary: SharonAI Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a material definitive agreement for a private placement of common stock and pre-funded warrants raising ~$900 million in gross proceeds. The offering comprises ~6.72 million shares at $68.73 per share and ~6.37 million pre-funded warrants at $68.2799 each. Proceeds will fund a strategic compute collaboration with NVIDIA. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, or similar event. It is a routine equity issuance in the ordinary course of business.
